title: Origin story: Set
description: Set was the brother of Osiris and Isis, god of the desert's red land and its storms. Jealous of Osiris's kingship, he murdered him and seized the throne, then fought Horus for eighty years before the gods' tribunal. Yet he also rode Ra's barque nightly, spearing Apophis — chaos turned against greater chaos.
